title: LargeTalk Pharo spike — v0 working, loop closed
content:
2026-04-20 spike validated the "live-image harness Claude can reshape" concept end-to-end. Location: /home/invidious/repos/largetalk-spike/.

SUBSTRATE: Pharo 12 (headless), 52MB image, ZnServer on 127.0.0.1:7270. Zero classpath, zero build step, single process. bootstrap.st installs 3 classes (LargeTalkMCP/LargeTalkMCPTool/LargeTalkCore) and registers 8 tools via <mcpTool: 'name' description: 'desc'> class-side pragmas. start-mcp.sh boots + blocks on Semaphore.

PROVEN:
1. MCP handshake (initialize/tools/list/tools/call) over plain JSON to pharo.
2. Pragma-based tool discovery: scan all globals' class-side methodDicts for #mcpTool:description: pragma → auto-register.
3. Install-mid-session: via image_compile tool, sent a new greet: method with <mcpTool> pragma → subsequent tools/list returned 9 tools including greet → tools/call greet executed the new method. ZERO daemon restart.
4. Hot-patch: recompiled greet: with different body → next call returned new output. Method-dict swap on live server.
5. Introspection available: image_eval exposed full Smalltalk (10,419 classes / 138,228 methods reachable); senders_of/implementors_of give graph-level traversal for free.

ARTIFACTS:
- bootstrap.st: ~320 LOC Smalltalk installing the shim (uses Smalltalk globals at: #Name dynamic lookup to sidestep parse-time undeclared-variable errors for classes being created in the same eval)
- demo.py: end-to-end reproducer (initialize → list → install → call → patch → call)
- README.md: full writeup + wiring instructions for ~/.claude/.claude.json

NOTES AND GOTCHAS FOUND:
- Pharo 12 Opal compiler does parse-time variable checking, so a single do-it cannot both create a class AND compile into it by literal name. Workaround: use `Smalltalk globals at: #X` lookup.
- Temp declarations `| ... |` must be at the top of a do-it before all statements.
- NonInteractiveTranscript lacks #lf; use `String lf` as a character argument OR `Stdio stdout`.
- `FileStream` is gone in Pharo 12; use `Stdio stdout` / `Stdio stderr`.
- Subclass builder emits deprecation warnings (use #package: #tag: instead of the compound); cosmetic, not blocking.

NEXT MOVES (not yet done):
- Input schemas: currently all {type:object, properties:{}}. Extend pragma: <mcpTool:description:schema:> with a STON literal for JSON Schema.
- doesNotUnderstand: synthesis loop: unknown selector → LLM proposes body → rule-packet gate → compile:classified: install → retry. This is the reflexivity payoff.
- Port rule-packet AST (Predicate/AllPred/EqPred/ApplyPred) to Smalltalk classes with double-dispatch #evaluateOn:. Audit identity vs Rust evaluator on shared witness set. Tests whether authoring packets in a live image beats JSON-over-MCP.
- Debugger-adapter: on Error in a tool invocation, suspend process, POST event over MCP, await a proceed/fix.
- Session management, SSE transport (both deferred — plain JSON works for Claude Code's HTTP MCP client).

Tags: pharo, largetalk-spike, mcp-shim, live-image-harness, hot-patch-proven, pragma-discovery, daystrom-mk2-alternative, experiment-v0-done
